feeding-the-raccoon-acceptable-fruit-ber.text: If the player does not have the fourth medallion fragment in their bank or inventory:

steps.text: The raccoon takes your fruit and drops a mysterious piece of a medallion it was holding. You take it.

feeding-the-raccoon-acceptable-fruit-ber.text: If the player has the fourth medallion fragment in their bank or inventory, or has already created the medallion of the deep:

steps.text: The raccoon doesn't seem hungry right now.
